d:
Dipon ka parv dipavli ko lekar jahan bajar saj-dhajkar taiyar hain. vahin mitti ko apne pasine se sinchkar diye aur bartan banane vale kumharon ke chehron par mayusi chhaee huee hai. kabhi tyoharon ke samay din-rat chalne vale kumharon ke chak ab lagbhag tham se gae hain. paranprik mitti ke diyon ka sthan ab chamachmati rang-birangi chini chainij laiton aur jhalron ne le liya hai. is badalte daur men kumhar samaj apne purvajon ke is paranprik vyavsay ko mahaj majburi men sanbhale hue hai.
